# Kwonnet

> Kwonnet - Connecting the dots and nodes. A social web application for sharing posts, discovering conversations, connecting with people and creators, and playing games.

The canonical website is https://kwonnet.com/. Kwonnet includes public posts and profiles, topic discovery, community connections, games, and private encrypted messaging. Interactive and personalized features may require sign-in.

Public posts are user-generated content, not official statements or endorsements by Kwonnet. Access to a post depends on its author's visibility settings and the post's current availability. The sitemap provides links to eligible public posts; it is not a directory of private messages or account records.

For policies, use the linked policy pages and their displayed update dates. Game rewards, coins, tips, payments, and subscriptions are subject to the applicable rules and eligibility conditions; participation does not guarantee earnings. Private messages, notifications, settings, wallets, and account histories are not public reference material. This overview does not grant access to restricted content or replace robots.txt.

## Website

- [Kwonnet homepage](https://kwonnet.com/): Main entry point for the platform and its public community content.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://kwonnet.com/privacy-policy): Information about data collection, use, sharing, retention, security, and privacy choices.
- [Terms of Service](https://kwonnet.com/terms-of-service): Account and content rules, games, rewards, payments, subscriptions, moderation, and service conditions.

## Optional

- [Sitemap index](https://kwonnet.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of sitemaps for public pages and eligible public posts.
- [Robots.txt](https://kwonnet.com/robots.txt): Published crawler access guidance and the sitemap location.
- [Kwonnet support](mailto:support@kwonnet.com): Contact for account, privacy, content, payment, and service questions.
